title: AM GENERAL LLC: STRUCTURE:FIFTH WHEEL ASSEMBLY (844 affected)
summary: THE INVOLVED VEHICLES MAY HAVE AN INSUFFICIENT WELDING OF THE SPACER ASSEMBLIES TO WHICH THE FIFTH WHEEL ASSEMBLY IS ATTACHED.

title: TRANSPORTATION MFG. CORP.: EQUIPMENT:EMERGENCY EXIT LABEL (320 affected)
summary: THE INVOLVED VEHICLES HAVE INSUFFICIENT INSTRUCTIONS AND INCORRECT LOCATIONS OF EMERGENCY EXIT DECALS ON THE INTERIOR OF THE BUS. AS A RESULT, THEY DO NOT COMPLY WITH FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD NO. 217, "BUS WINDOW RETENTION AND RELEASE".

title: Cooper Tire & Rubber Co.: TIRES:CORD (126 affected)
summary: TIRES MAY DEVELOP SEPARATION OF THE REINFORCING PLIES FROM THE RUBBER COMPOUND. TIRES FAILED THE HIGH SPEED TEST REQUIREMENTS OF FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD NO. 109, "NEW PNEUMATIC TIRES".

title: DANA CORPORATION: STEERING:LINKAGES:DRAG:POWER ASSIST SYSTEM (36,558 affected)
summary: THE DRAG LINK ADAPTOR THREADS MAY UNDERGO ABNORMAL WEAR DUE TO IMPROPER CONNECTION OF THE ADAPTOR TO THE POWER STEERING VALVE HOUSING.

title: VETTER: EQUIPMENT:MOTORCYCLE SADDLEBAG (614 affected)
summary: THE LEFT HAND SADDLEBAG MOUNTING ASSEMBLY MAY COME INTO CONTACT WITH THE REAR BRAKE CALIPER. THIS COULD CAUSE THE REAR BRAKES TO FAIL.

title: WHITE MOTOR CORPORATION: BRAKES:AIR SYSTEMS:AIR SUPPLY:RESERVOIR:WET:DRY (100 affected)
summary: CERTAIN VEHICLES MAY NOT COMPLY WITH FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD NO. 12I, "AIR BRAKE SYSTEMS". THIS REQUIRES THE AIR TANK CAPACITY TO BE AT LEAST TWELVE TIMES AS LARGE AS THE BRAKE CHAMBER VOLUME, TO PROVIDE ADEQUATE RESERVES FOR SITUATIONS WHICH MAY REQUIRE REPEATED BRAKE APPLICATIONS.

title: LA SALLE-DEITCH CO., INC.: SUSPENSION:SINGLE AXLE:REAR:NON-POWER AXLE (40 affected)
summary: THE WELD THAT JOINS THE SPINDLE TO THE AXLE MAY FAIL. SUCH A FAILURE WOULD CAUSE THE WHEEL, TIRE AND AXLE HUB TO SEPARATE FROM THE VEHICLE.

title: General Motors, LLC: ELECTRICAL SYSTEM:BATTERY:CABLE (1,550 affected)
summary: A MISROUTING OF THE POSITIVE BATTERY CABLE MAY EXIST. THIS MAY CAUSE DAMAGE TO THE POSITIVE BATTERY CABLE INSULATION DUE TO RUBBING ON THE RIGHT FRONT METAL BRAKE TUBE. SHOULD THIS OCCUR, THE WIRE IN THE CABLE MAY CONTACT AND DAMAGE THE BRAKE TUBE, CAUSING LOSS OF BRAKE FLUID.

title: INDIANA MILLS, INC.: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:ACTIVE RESTRAINTS:BELT BUCKLES (2,636 affected)
summary: THERE IS THE POSSIBILITY THAT THE PUSH BUTTON ON THE BUCKLE COULD BREAK.

title: COACHMEN INDUSTRIES, INC.: STRUCTURE:FRAME AND MEMBERS(GIVE SIDE/END) (190 affected)
summary: THE "A" FRAMES ON THE VEHICLES HAVE THE POTENTIAL TO CRACK DUE TO SUBSTITUTION A FRAME STEEL AND IMPROPER TIE DOWN PROCEDURES DURING DELIVERY. ALSO, INADEQUATE WELD MAY ALLOW SEPARATION OF THE MOUNTING PLATE FROM THE CROSSMEMBER. DETACHED MOUNTING PLATES COULD RESULT IN CANTING (SLANTING) OF THE TIRE AND WHEEL.

title: RENAULT, INCORPORATED: AIR CONDITIONER (3,825 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN VEHICLES, THE WIRING HARNESS FOR THE AIR CONDITIONER MAY PROVIDE POWER TO THE IGNITION CIRCUIT WHILE THE KEY IS IN THE OFF POSITION.

title: RENAULT, INCORPORATED: EQUIPMENT:SPEED CONTROL (750 affected)
summary: ON CERTAIN VEHICLES, THE CRUISE CONTROL ACTUATION CHAIN COULD CATCH ON CERTAIN CARBURETOR HARDWARE, CAUSING THE THROTTLE PLATE TO REMAIN IN A PARTIALLY OPEN POSITION.

title: Ford Motor Company: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:LINES:HOSE:NON-METALLIC (10,000 affected)
summary: CERTAIN VEHICLES WERE EQUIPPED WITH FRONT BRAKE HOSE ASSEMBLIES THAT WERE INCORRECTLY MANUFACTURED BY THE SUPPLIER. THESE ASSEMBLIES, BOTH RH AND LH, WERE INCORRECTLY BUILT WITH THE FITTINGS MISORIENTED BY 90 DEGREES. THIS COULD CAUSE CHAFING OF THE BRAKE HOSE THROUGH CONTACT WITH THE ADJACENT TIRE DURING FULL TURNS. CONTINUED CHAFING COULD RESULT IN A BRAKE FLUID LEAK.

title: Ford Motor Company: ELECTRICAL SYSTEM:IGNITION:SWITCH:NEUTRAL START (14,000 affected)
summary: THE INVOLVED VEHICLES MAY START IN REVERSE GEAR. THIS DOES NOT COMPLY WITH FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD NO. 102, "TRANSMISSION SHIFT LEVER SEQUENCE, STARTER INTERLOCK, AND TRANSMISSION BRAKING AFFECT". SOME OF THESE VEHICLES MAY BE EQUIPPED WITH A DEFECTIVE NEUTRAL START SWITCH THAT OCCASIONALLY PERMITS ENGINE STARTING WITH THE TRANSMISSION SHIFT LEVER IN THE REVERSE ("R") POSITION.

title: THOMAS BUILT BUSES, INC.: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:SEAT TRACKS AND ANCHORS (57 affected)
summary: SOME OF THE INVOLVED VEHICLES HAVE BEEN RELEASED WITHOUT THE SEATS BEING PROPERLY FASTENED TO THE FLOOR AND SEAT RAIL OF THE VEHICLE. THIS FAILS TO COMPLY WITH FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD NO. 222, "SCHOOL BUS PASSENGER SEATING AND CRASH PROTECTION".

title: SAAB CARS USA, INC.: FUEL:FUEL INJECTION:ELECTRICAL (15,213 affected)
summary: THE POSSIBILITY EXISTS THAT THE MOUNTING COLLAR FOR THE ELECTRIC FUEL PUMP, SUBMERGED IN THE FUEL, COULD PARTIALLY DETACH FROM THE TOP OF THE TANK AND CAUSE A FUEL LEAK.

title: THOMAS BUILT BUSES, INC.: EQUIPMENT:EMERGENCY EXIT LABEL (57 affected)
summary: THE INVOLVED VEHICLES HAVE EMERGENCY EXIT LABELS OF LESS THAN THE TWO INCH HEIGHT REQUIRED BY FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD NO. 217, "BUS WINDOW RETENTION AND RELEASE".

title: DANA CORPORATION: SUSPENSION:INDEPENDENT FRONT CONTROL ARM:UNKNOWN T (35,411 affected)
summary: BALL JOINTS MAY CONTAIN A 35/64 INCH THICK CASTELLATED NUT INSTEAD OF THE CORRECT 23/32 INCH THICK NUT. DUE TO THE INCORRECT SIZE, THE NUT MAY LOOSEN UNTIL IT COMES INTO CONTACT WITH THE COTTER PIN. CORRESPONDING LOOSENING OF THE TAPERED BALL STUD COULD LEAD TO FRACTURE OF THE BALL JOINT STUD. THIS WOULD RESULT IN SEPARATION OF THE BALL JOINT TO STEERING KNUCKLE CONNECTION AND COLLAPSE OF THE LOWER PART OF THE WHEEL ASSEMBLY.

title: Harley-Davidson Motor Company: SUSPENSION:INDEPENDENT FRONT:BEARING WHEEL (4,262 affected)
summary: THE WHEEL BEARINGS ON THE INVOLVED MOTORCYCLES MAY HAVE HAD INADEQUATE INITIAL BEARING LUBRICATIONS AND SEALING. DEPENDING ON THE DEGREE OF INSUFFICIENT LUBRICATION, THIS PROBLEM COULD CAUSE FAILURE OF THE FRONT AND/OR REAR WHEEL BEARINGS.

title: General Motors, LLC: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:LINKAGE:PEDAL (4,615 affected)
summary: THE INVOLVED VEHICLES MAY HAVE BEEN ASSEMBLED WITH A BRAKE PEDAL SUPPORT BRACKET WHICH WAS DESIGNED FOR USE IN DIESEL ENGINE VEHICLES. THE INCORRECT BRACKET MAY CAUSE THE SERVICE BRAKES TO REMAIN PARTIALLY APPLIED, RESULTING IN BRAKE OVERHEATING AND REDUCED BRAKING EFFECTIVENESS.

title: RENAULT, INCORPORATED: EQUIPMENT:CARRIER:SPARE TIRE (6,500 affected)
summary: CERTAIN VEHICLES EQUIPPED WITH FACTORY-INSTALLED AIR-CONDITIONING MAY HAVE DEFECTIVE SPARE TIRE RESTRAINTS. VEHICLES SO EQUIPPED HAVE THE SPARE TIRE STORED ON THE FLOOR IN THE CARGO AREA.
